scripts.build:chrome: vite build --mode chrome --outDir dist/chrome && bun scripts/generate-manifest.ts chrome dist/chrome/manifest.json
scripts.build:firefox: vite build --mode firefox --outDir dist/firefox && bun scripts/generate-manifest.ts firefox dist/firefox/manifest.json
scripts.build: bun run build:chrome && bun run build:firefox
scripts.zip: bun run build && cd dist/chrome && zip -rq ../../zerostash-chrome.zip . && cd ../firefox && zip -rq ../../zerostash-firefox.xpi .
